summary: Verify and fix the 21.10 review findings of the FBL audit branch, one agent per file group in its own worktree

issues.what: Reproduced on dd6a52a with the merged forecast shape (review2/season/ka2.mjs): 82-game calendar, Out for 12 games. Published forecast.games 53.5, Season tab 47.0 (U=55, ESPN 60). With U=70/ESPN 68: 63.9 vs 59.8. With U=55/ESPN 45: 46.0 vs 47.0. On the projection-inputs harness DB (pi/after-schedule.json) the Season tab gave Porzingis 35.7 games against a published 46.0, and Moody 45.4 against 29.7. Fix in playRate: when forecast.knownAbsence.gamesLeft>0, prior = clamp(forecast.games/gamesLeft). This applies whatever today's report says, because F already excludes the blocked games. The old max(F, unconditional)/82 now applies only to Out reports the build did not block. After the fix the Season tab matches the forecast: Porzingis 46.7, Butler 33.9 (33.6), Moody 30.6 (29.7), Gueye 60.0 (59.8), Quaintance 32.9 (32.4). Synthetic cases give exactly F. Inside season.js only playRate needed the change: expectedPoints, playerPicture, injuredTargets and bestTransfers all read playRate.
issues.tests: tests/review-season-core.test.js 'a known absence (merged build shape)...': season games == F for F<U, F>U and a third case; with no report, 82*F/gamesLeft. Fails on dd6a52a.

issues.what: Same mechanism as R33, fixed once. Reproduced (review2/season/ka.mjs): rookie with availability:null, forecast.games=30, knownAbsence 41 blocked/41 left, U 60. Season games 14.63 (playRate .366) against the published 30. After the fix: 29.27 (30 x the .976 share of the remaining dated games). The knownAbsence branch fixes it. The report-free fallback chain is now availability.unconditionalGames ?? knownAbsence.unconditionalGames ?? sources.model.games. That matters when the build blocked the whole season (gamesLeft 0) but today's report dates a return: the rookie now gets 41*60/82 games, not 0.41.
issues.tests: tests/review-season-core.test.js 'a rookie with a known absence is not cut twice...': 30 games, and 41*60/82 for the season-ending block. Fails on dd6a52a.

issues.what: Duplicate of R12 (rookies with a dated Out counted twice). Fixed by the same playRate change. Harness DB: Quaintance's share is now .549 = F/gamesLeft (was .411); Izaiyah Nelson .407 = 28.1/69.
issues.tests: Covered by the R12 test in tests/review-season-core.test.js.

issues.what: Reproduced (skeptic-ret/repro.mjs). Forecast 70 games; he played 10, then missed 30. While Out: share .796. Same day after a downgrade to GTD: .451. After his first game back with the report gone: .460, and 18.9 games for the rest of the season against 33.4. The fitted spellMisses=4 (scripts/inseason_calibration.py return_cases) caps the trailing run at the first game back; the app applied it only while keptOut. I measured the post-return rule on data/raw 2023-26 with the script's own functions (scratchpad/season-core/post_return2.py). Rule: cap the latest completed spell of 10+ misses at 4, no report needed. Holdout 2025/26, t+1..t+40 after the first game back (857 cases): MAE .2642 -> .2449, MSE .0968 -> .0914, bias -.066 -> +.089. Fit pair (765 cases): MAE .2794 -> .2257. All ordinary availability checkpoints are neutral: holdout MAE .1896 -> .1895, MSE .0620 -> .0625. Capping a trailing run without a report hurts (MAE .244 -> .311), so that stays report-gated. Changes in playRate: (1) the trailing run is capped under any report that is not season-ending (Out, Suspension, Day-To-Day/GTD) or under the build's knownAbsence block; (2) the latest completed run of >=spellGames misses before his last game, counted over the club's finished games plus his rows, counts at most CALIBRATION.availability.spellMissesAfterReturn ?? spellMisses; (3) team never drops below games played. After the fix: B .796, C .802 (32.9 games), D .822. An unreported trailing run still counts in full (.451).
issues.tests: tests/review-season-core.test.js 'after a long absence the share does not collapse...': Out, GTD downgrade, first game back, 5 games back, a run shorter than a spell, an unreported trailing run, a knownAbsence-covered trailing run without a report. Fails on dd6a52a. The existing test 'while a report keeps him out...' is unchanged and passes.

issues.what: Reproduced (season/gtd.mjs, gtd-skeptic/real.mjs). GTD returnDate 2026-10-21; calendar Moscow 22, 24, 25 and 27.10. At 23:00 MSK the factors are .5,1,1,1; at 03:00 MSK on 22.10 they are .5,.5,.5,1. Grayson Allen's week fell 2.22 -> 1.34 overnight. Fix: injuryFactor(injury,day,today,usToday=today) judges the GTD return date and its 3-day fallback against usToday. expectedPoints derives usToday from ctx.now when given (UTC-5, like usDay). Otherwise it uses the Moscow date, or the day before while the club has a US-evening game filed under today's Moscow date with no score yet. So no wall clock is read, and daytime stale reports keep the documented 3-day fallback (the verifier warned against addDays(today,-1)). After the fix, Allen's week is 2.21 at 23:00, 03:00 and 07:30 MSK; the other 46 GTD players behave the same. Remaining gap: between the end of the night games and the collector writing their scores (around 08:00-10:00 MSK), a stale report with a return date of the day before can still read as fresh.
issues.tests: tests/review-season-core.test.js 'from 00:00 MSK on game night...': evening, night, ctx.now at 03:00, daytime stale fallback, and the 4-argument injuryFactor. Fails on dd6a52a.

issues.what: Reproduced (season/dip.mjs, skeptic-dip/race.mjs). Standings fixture: team 0's total fell from 1024.4 to 944.0 the moment its 5 starters checked in, and P(1st) went 12.5% -> 2.3%. Fix in expectedPoints: a game in ctx.running adds (perGame - GAME_PLAYED) x the share still to play. The +1 for the game is already in the running points. The share left comes from ESPN's clock in run.game.detail ('8:22 - 3rd', '45.2 - 4th', 'Halftime', 'End of 1st', '2:00 - OT'; 48 regulation minutes), else from his minutes against his expected minutes, and is 0 for a final. No injury factor or share applies, since he is on the floor. It is not added to `games` (not a game left), so the existing test 'a running or already listed game is not expected again' (games) still holds. Transfer gains never pass ctx.running, so they still exclude the game. Race fixture after the fix: team 0 is at 1039.0 at tip-off (starters now certain to play) and 1036.5 at halftime with 10 points each.
issues.tests: tests/review-season-core.test.js 'a running game adds its points so far and the rest of it...': each clock format, minutes fallback, final, game outside the window, games unchanged. Fails on dd6a52a.

issues.what: Reproduced (season/rx.mjs, season-ending-skeptic/ep.mjs). 'continues to work back from the season-ending surgery he underwent in March' read as season-ending and gave 0 games. So did 'who missed the remainder of the season last year' and 'was out for the season last year'. 'will miss the rest of the regular season' and 'shut down for the remainder of the regular season' were not recognised. 'out for the rest of the season series' and 'miss the season finale' also matched. Fix: 'season-ending' now counts only after sustain/suffer/undergo/underwent/require/need. The comment is split into parts (sentences, semicolons, ', '), and a part is skipped when it names last/previous/past season|year|campaign, 'a year ago', 'missed (all|most|much)? (of)? the entire|rest|remainder|entirety|balance', 'was out for', or a year before 2026 (which also covers tags like 2025-26). 'regular[- ]' is now optional before 'season'. The opener lookahead also covers finale, series and debut. On the deployed feed (90 entries) and the live 21.10 snapshot (81) the result is unchanged: Veesaar, Oweh, Simmons (OFS), Furphy and Hukporti. Known limit: a current shutdown whose same clause also names a past year ('…after re-tearing the ACL he tore last year') is missed.
issues.tests: tests/review-season-core.test.js 'a past season-ending injury in the comment does not end this season...': 7 negatives and 8 positives, plus season games. Fails on dd6a52a. The existing seasonEnding tests in tests/season-availability.test.js still pass.

issues.what: Reproduced on the deployed data (cup-skeptic/rep.mjs, season/pic2.mjs): Hardaway, Bridges, Barnes, Champagnie, Shead and Carrington showed 79.54 of 80 club games (99%) while playRate is .970. expectedPoints now returns clubGames: the club games left in the window, over the same seasonCalendar (NBA Cup placeholders included), tourDate window and filters it expects, including ctx.now/running/done. playerPicture uses it. Now 79.54 of 82 = 97.0% = playRate. explainSwap's split reads the same number.
issues.tests: tests/review-season-core.test.js 'a player picture counts the NBA Cup games...': clubGames 82 and expectedGames/clubGames == playRate. Fails on dd6a52a. The existing clubGames 0 assertion in tests/season-transfers.test.js still passes.

issues.what: Duplicate of R18 (playerPicture clubGames ignored seasonCalendar placeholders). Fixed by the same change.

Reproduced (season/zero.mjs, zero-skeptic/repro.mjs). One played row with minutes '0', from an ESPN MIN '0' line via withBoxScores, made perGame drop the calibrated estimator for the whole season: `minutes` was undefined and the plain shrink was used. A Sports.ru '00:04' row went through the estimator. perGame now falls back only when a played row has no minutes at all (null/undefined/''). A real 0 is an m=0 game, as '0:01' is. withBoxScores and liveGamePoints are untouched (not mine to change).
issues.tests: tests/review-season-core.test.js 'an ESPN line with MIN 0 keeps the calibrated estimate...': minutes defined, value within .01 of the '0:01' cameo, missing minutes still fall back. Fails on dd6a52a. The golden fixture test still passes.

issues.what: Checked in season.js. (a) ctx.now: season.js already honours it in expectedPoints (drops tipped games), and now also uses it for the US day (R14). No caller passes it; that is wiring in season-ui.js and scripts/notify-transfers.mjs (see crossGroupNotes). Defaulting ctx.now inside season.js library functions would make them read the wall clock and break fixed-date callers and tests, so I did not. (b) 'unsure': already removed. liveGamePoints no longer creates it, and grep finds no use in src/scripts/tests. (c) The UI label (season-ui.js injuryInfo:116-117 and the candidate box) still checks OFS only; season.js already exports seasonEnding, so it is a season-ui change. Nothing to change in my file.

result.crossGroupNotes:
season-ui (src/season-ui.js):
1. R20a: pass `now:Date.now()` in the ctx used for transfer gains: transferOptions, bestTransfers, recommendPackage, bestPackage, injuredTargets/acquisition, marketAlerts, transferVerdict/packageVerdict (context() at season-ui.js:55, or a copy for those views).
   - For leagueRace/ahead()/teamKpis it is optional. With now, a tipped game is dropped for players not in `running` (bench players before they check in, DNPs). Players in running get the R15 remainder either way.
   - season.js also uses ctx.now to tell the US day for GTD reports. Without it, it falls back to the calendar.
2. R20c: in injuryInfo (season-ui.js:116-117) and the candidate box (~342), use `seasonEnding(i)` from season.js for 'до конца сезона' instead of `i.fantasyStatus==='OFS'`. Today Furphy shows 'до ~02.01' and Hukporti 'до ~01.10' while the model gives them 0 games.
3. R15: race()'s cache key (season-ui.js:177) is `${id}:${x.points}:${x.day}`. The expected remainder of a running game now depends on the clock (x.game.detail) and x.minutes. Add them to the key so the forecast moves with the clock between scoring plays. livePoints already puts game (with detail) and minutes on each entry, which is what expectedPoints reads.
4. playerPicture.clubGames now comes from expectedPoints (outlook.clubGames). The 'в периоде X из Y матчей клуба' line needs no change.

notify-transfers (scripts/notify-transfers.mjs:36): add `now:Date.now()` to ctx (R20a; the notifier has no box scores, so games of the night not yet scored still count as gainable).

live.js (optional): if eventInfo carried ESPN status.period and status.displayClock, livePoints could pass a structured share of the game left. season.js parses shortDetail ('8:22 - 3rd', '45.2 - 4th', 'Halftime', 'End of 1st', '2:00 - OT'); other formats fall back to the player's minutes.

model group (scripts/projection_model.py ENDING/absence(), R31): read exactly the wording src/season.js seasonEnding accepts.
- It applies only to keptOut entries: status matches /out|suspension/i and fantasyStatus != 'GTD'. OFS always counts, whatever the status. Python's absence() currently applies ENDING to any entry.
- With SEASON='2026-27', the comment is split by /[.;!?](?:\s|$)|,\s/. A part counts when it matches OVER (case-insensitive) and is not 'earlier':
  - OVER = `\bout for (the )?(2026-27 )?(regular[- ])?season\b(?![- ](opener|finale|series|debut))` | `\b(sustain|suffer|undergo|underwent|require|need)\w*\s+(an?\s+)?season[- ]ending\b` | `\bmiss the (entire |rest of the |remainder of the )?(2026-27 )?(regular[- ])?season\b(?![- ](opener|finale|series|debut))` | `\b(remainder|rest|entirety|balance) of the (2026-27 )?(regular[- ])?season\b(?![- ](opener|finale|series|debut))`
  - earlier = PAST `\b(last|previous|past) (season|year|campaign)\b|\ba year ago\b|\bmissed (all |most |much )?(of )?the (entire|rest|remainder|entirety|balance)\b|\bwas out for\b`, or any `\b20\d\d\b` year below 2026.
- Today's Python ENDING (`out for (the )?season|miss the (entire|rest of the|20\d\d-\d\d) season`) misses Furphy ('remainder of the season') and Hukporti ('sustained a season-ending'). It also matches 'out for the season opener'.

calibration (scripts/inseason_calibration.py, data/inseason-calibration.json, tests/fixtures/inseason-golden.json):
- playRate now also caps the latest completed 10+ spell after the return, at `availability.spellMissesAfterReturn ?? spellMisses`.
- Please add return checkpoints t+1..t+40 to return_cases and fit spellMissesAfterReturn on the FIT pair by MSE. My replay (scratchpad/season-core/post_return2.py) gives 6. Holdout 2025/26 return cases (857): MAE .2642 uncapped, .2449 at cap 4, .2437 at cap 6; bias -.066 / +.089 / +.062.
- Report it next to availabilityAtReturn.
- Update the limitation 'The spell weight is fitted at the first game back; in the app it applies while an injury report keeps the player out.' The cap now applies to the trailing run while any non-season-ending report (or the build's knownAbsence) covers it, and after the return to the latest 10+ spell.
- Optionally add a post-return case to the golden fixture.
result.docNotes:
docs/ACCEPTANCE.md (owners of docs):
- Line 11 (in-season update) and line 124 (Availability):
  - A reported absence counts at most 4 missed games while any report that is not season-ending covers it (Out, Suspension or Day-To-Day/GTD), or the build's known absence does.
  - After his return, his latest spell of 10+ missed club games keeps counting as 4 misses, no report needed.
  - Replay with scripts/inseason_calibration.py's functions: 2025/26 holdout, t+1..t+40 after the first game back, 857 cases: share MAE 0.264 -> 0.245, bias -0.066 -> +0.089. Fit pair: 0.279 -> 0.226. All availability checkpoints unchanged: 0.1896 -> 0.1895.
  - Example: forecast 70 games, 10 played then 30 missed. The day after his return his share is 0.80 instead of 0.46; rest of season 32.9 instead of 18.9 games.
- Known absence:
  - When the build blocked a dated ESPN absence (forecast.knownAbsence), the in-season share is forecast.games/gamesLeft. The forecast is the mean of ESPN and the model over the games left (owner decision 4), so the Season tab shows the published games.
  - Harness 21.10: Porzingis 46.7 (was 35.7), Butler 33.9 (27.2), Moody 30.6 (45.4), rookie Quaintance 32.9 (23.7).
  - A rookie's report-free games come from knownAbsence.unconditionalGames.
- GTD at night: a day-to-day return date is compared with the US day. That is the day before the Moscow date while a US-evening game of today's Moscow date has no score (from 00:00 MSK), or the US day of ctx.now when given. Example: Grayson Allen's week stays 2.21 games overnight instead of falling to 1.34. The 3-day fallback for a stale report is unchanged.
- Line 136 (running game): a running game is not a game left. The projected total is the running points plus his counting points per game times the share of the game still to play, from ESPN's clock (48 regulation minutes; minutes played vs expected when there is no clock; nothing once final), so the forecast no longer dips at tip-off. Transfer gains still exclude it.
- Season-ending wording:
  - OFS, or for an Out/Suspension report: 'out for the season', 'miss the (entire / rest of the / remainder of the) (2026-27) (regular) season', '(remainder|rest|entirety|balance) of the (2026-27) (regular) season'.
  - 'season-ending' counts only after sustain/suffer/undergo/underwent/require/need.
  - Not: the season opener, finale, series or debut, or the start of the season.
  - A sentence or comma part naming last/previous season, a year ago, an earlier year (2025, 2025-26), 'missed the rest of' or 'was out for' is ignored.
  - The 90-entry deployed feed classifies as before: Veesaar, Oweh, Simmons, Furphy, Hukporti.
- Transfer explanation: 'в периоде X из Y матчей клуба' counts the 2 NBA Cup games Sports.ru has not listed yet. Example: Hardaway 79.5 of 82 = 97%, not of 80 = 99%.
- Points per game: an ESPN line with MIN '0' (a few seconds) is a 0-minute game in the calibrated estimator, like Sports.ru's '00:04'. Only a row without minutes falls back to the 10-game shrink.
result.risks:
- R11 post-return cap:
  - It needs no report, so a 10+ DNP-CD run or a late signing (club games before his first one) is also capped at 4 once he plays. The measured gain includes such cases (the backtest has no reports). Before, these counted in full, which was also wrong for late signings.
  - The holdout bias at cap 4 is +0.09. The calibration owner should fit spellMissesAfterReturn (6 on the fit pair).
  - A trailing run whose report ESPN drops before he plays, with no knownAbsence, still counts in full until he plays.
  - Spells are read over the union of the club's finished dates and his rows. For a traded player this rarely forms a 10+ run, but check.
- R14: between the night games ending and the collector writing their scores (daytime), a stale GTD dated the day before is read as fresh, so later games get 1 instead of .5. Passing ctx.now in the UI/notifier removes this.
- R15:
  - Running entries without a clock or minutes add (perGame-1) x (1 - 0/expected) = a whole game.
  - The remainder ignores foul trouble and blowouts (clock-based).
  - The race cache key in season-ui does not include the clock yet.
- R16: a current shutdown whose same clause also names an earlier year or 'last season' is missed (false negative), for example 'will miss the rest of the season after re-tearing the ACL he tore last year'. A false negative keeps games after ESPN's placeholder date; a false positive zeroes the season.
- R10: the prior uses F/gamesLeft even after ESPN clears the player early. It is right until the next build drops knownAbsence. A gamesLeft that is stale relative to a much later report is not re-derived.
- expectedPoints now returns {points, games, clubGames}. No caller deep-compares it.
- node_modules is a symlink in the worktree and shows as untracked ('node_modules/' in .gitignore matches directories only). It is not committed. public/data is copied and ignored.

issues.what: Reproduced on dd6a52a with review2/shadow-skeptic/repro.mjs pointed at my worktree (deployed 20.10 public/data). Setup: team 4 buys Jokic (team 0's player) and sells Zubac, on 21.10. stints() marks team 4's holding shadowed and teamPoints credits a 40-point Jokic game only to team 0, but leagueRace still raised team 4's total from 12582 to 14011 (Jokic's rest-of-season 2515 included), P(1st) from 3.0% to 17.3% and P(top-3) from 16.8% to 50.0%. Team 0's P(1st) fell from 33.1% to 28.6%. The fix adds shadowedHoldings(ctx) to src/standings.js: a Map of 'team:id' to the first holder, built from stints(ctx.transfers,ctx.picks) by keeping open holdings where shadowed(s) is true. leagueRace drops those ids from now, rest, week and variance. A new windowAhead(ctx,t,p,w,running,shadow) in standings.js returns {0,0} for such a holding, and season-ui's ahead() (used by playerRow and teamKpis) now calls it. The affected player row reads '⚖️ Его очки получает <first holder>: она взяла его раньше. Здесь он приносит 0, пока нарушение не исправлено'. 'doubt' holdings are not shadowed, so both teams keep the player. After the fix: team 4 total 11496, P(1st) 0.3%, P(top-3) 3.7%; team 0 P(1st) 33.9%, P(top-3) 73.7%, matching the reviewer's shadow-aware row exactly. I also ran a scratch-only DOM smoke test (vite SSR + happy-dom) on the 21.10 live snapshot with the purchase injected into team 4's journal. Team 4's season KPI shows 0 / 11 496 and its Jokic row 0 / 0 with the note. Team 0's Jokic row shows 0 / 2 515. On the Overview, team 0 reads 14 290 and team 4 reads 11 496 with 1% for 1st, the same numbers as the Teams tab.
issues.tests: New tests/review-season-ui.test.js has three tests for this. (1) Synthetic league: team 0 buys #81 on 22.10, team 1 buys him on 23.10, running 40 points for #81. Asserts now = 40 for team 0 and 0 for team 1, team 1's rest and sd equal those of its other nine players, team 0's rest includes him, team 0's P(1st) is far above team 1's, shadowedHoldings gives [['1:81',0]], windowAhead gives {0,0} for team 1 and 40+expected for team 0, and once team 0 sells him on 26.10 team 1 gets him. Before the fix it fails with 40 !== 0. (2) A doubt holding (same watcher window): both teams keep now = 40 and his rest. (3) A source check that season-ui's ahead goes through windowAhead with shadowedHoldings.

issues.what: Same defect as R22, reproduced through the review2/season/shared.mjs scenario: team 0 buys #81 on 22.10, team 1 buys #81 on 23.10. Before the fix team 1's rest included #81 and running {81: 40} gave now = 40 to both teams. The R22 fix covers the running points (leagueRace now, windowAhead) and the forecast. Afterwards team 1 gets now = 0 and its rest and sd leave him out.
issues.tests: The first two tests in tests/review-season-ui.test.js described under R22 (the R13 scenario).

issues.what: Reproduced with review2/ui-standings/r8b.mjs on my worktree. The reviewer's calendar gives tour 13 = 13.01–18.01 and tour 14 = 19.01–24.01, and tourDate(MLK game of B on 18.01) = 19.01. Before the game, expectedPoints puts 1.94 games in tour 14 and 0 in tour 13. After it is played, windowFact gave tour 14 = 0 and tour 13 = 40. windowFact now filters games by a played game's tour day: a WeakMap index, per live.clubs, of `${club}|${date}` to tourDate(calendar entry, gameWeeks(live)), built only from entries that carry a week (dd6a52a keeps played games in the calendars as gone, with their week). The game is looked up in the opponent's calendar first, so a traded player's games for his old club are still found (a club plays once per Moscow date), then in the player's own club calendar, and if neither lists it, by its raw date. After the fix: tour 14 = 40, tour 13 = 0. The season fact still equals teamPoints. In the 21.10 06:50 snapshot all 93 game rows have opponents that match club keys, but its calendars carry no gone entries yet (it predates the new collector), so on that data the result is unchanged (raw-date fallback).
issues.tests: tests/review-season-ui.test.js 'period facts place a played game in its own tour'. Clubs A, B and D: an MLK tour-14 game of B against D filed on 18.01. Player 1 is on B with an ESPN-scored row that has no opponent. Player 2 played that game for B and is now on A (opponent D). Asserts tour 14 fact = 65, tour 13 = 0, each player's share, season fact = teamPoints, the same tour as expectedPoints before tip-off, and that a game no calendar lists counts on its own date. Before the fix it fails with 0 !== 65.

issues.what: Confirmed in scripts/availability_model.py hazards(): `for lag in range(1,6)` with weight decay**(lag-1), decay = .6. So ownShortPer82/ownLongPer82 cover the five seasons before 2026/27, each older season weighted 0.6 of the next, yet absenceRates headed them 'Пропуски по логам 2002–2026'. The head is now built from exported constants OWN_SEASONS = 5 and OWN_DECAY = .6: 'Пропуски по логам 5 последних сезонов (каждый более ранний — с весом 0,6 от следующего)'. healthLine (player card) and absenceShort (season tab) both use it.
issues.tests: A new test reads availability_model.py, checks that the lag range and the decay default equal OWN_SEASONS and OWN_DECAY, and asserts the exact head with no '2002' in the texts. Changed existing test: tests/season-ui.test.js 'health: own logged absence rates…'. Its two regexes for the old head now expect the new head, because the old wording was the bug.

issues.what: Label part: same fix as R26. Coverage part: confirmed in projection_model.evaluate. gamesCoverage80 comes from the chain anchored to the regression's games (p). deployedGamesCoverage80 comes from the healthy-start construction (q = deployed(...)), which is what apply() publishes as availability.gamesRange. In the full-run build the values are 0.7934 and 0.7872. rangeCoverage().games now reads only deployedGamesCoverage80. An older report without it quotes no games coverage, because its gamesCoverage80 also measured the regression chain: the healthy start has been published since #46, while the deployed figure was added only in 8634466. On the current build both round to 79 %, so the visible number does not change.
issues.tests: A new test checks that healthLine quotes 79 % from deployedGamesCoverage80 .7872, that rangeCoverage(audit).games is .7872 (before the fix .7934), and that an old audit with only gamesCoverage80 quotes nothing. issues.what: Confirmed on the 21.10 live ESPN report. Johnny Furphy: Out, fantasyStatus OUT, returnDate 2027-01-02, '…will miss the remainder of the season'. result.crossGroupNotes:
1. season.js (season-core): transfer advice (selling/transferOptions/bestTransfers/bestPackage/recommendPackage/explainSwap/marketAlerts) still values a shadowed holding at the player's full playerOutlook. So the later buyer is told selling him costs his whole forecast, and a package that sells him 'loses' those points, although the rule gives that slot 0 while the first holder keeps him. Value a shadowed holding at 0, for example with standings.js shadowedHoldings(ctx) or the same stints()/shadowed() check inside season.js. Doubt holdings keep their value.
2. season.js explainSwap (about line 640) prints the ESPN return date even for season-ending reports ('Out до 02.01 — проверь новости'). Use seasonEnding(injury) and say 'до конца сезона'. The check has to be inline: forecast-text.js imports season.js, so season.js cannot import injuryUntil.
3. season.js explainSwap (about lines 643-646): 'в расчёте N матчей по ESPN' prints f.games, which since 21.10 is the mean of ESPN and model games (gamesBasis MEAN_ESPN_MODEL), not ESPN's figure. It should name the combined games, or print sources.espn.projectedGames/games as ESPN's.
4. scripts/notify-transfers.mjs:53 and :190 (Telegram) print i.returnDate for season-ending OUT entries (the placeholder date, for example Furphy 'до 02.01'). They should follow seasonEnding as the app now does.
5. Collector (optional): storing `week` on player game rows would let windowFact skip the calendar lookup; tourDate already accepts {date, week}.

docs/ACCEPTANCE.md changes:
(a) Current state, shared players (line 25): add that the forecast follows the same rule. The league race (Overview totals, «В игре», «Игр до», P(1st)/P(top-3)) and the Teams tab's period forecasts leave out a holding another FBL team shadows (src/standings.js shadowedHoldings/windowAhead); purchases inside one watcher window ('doubt') count for both teams. Example on the 20.10 data, team 4 buying team 0's Jokic: team 4's total 14 011 → 11 496, P(1st) 17.3% → 0.3%, P(top-3) 50.0% → 3.7%, team 0's P(1st) 28.6% → 33.9%. The player row names the team his points go to.
(b) Line 9 says 'the 80% games range covers 79.3%'. That is the chain anchored to the regression's games. The published healthy-start games range covers 78.7% (holdout.deployedGamesCoverage80 = 0.787), and that is the figure the card quotes (79 %). A report without that field shows no games coverage.
(c) Line 183 (spells per 82 on cards): the player's own rates cover the last 5 seasons (2021/22–2025/26), each older season weighted 0.6 of the next (availability_model.hazards, lags 1-5). The card heads them «Пропуски по логам 5 последних сезонов (каждый более ранний — с весом 0,6 от следующего)», no longer «2002–2026».
(d) Teams tab period facts: a played game counts in its Sports.ru tour (tourDate, read from the club calendars' kept played games), the same tour expectedPoints gave it. For example, an MLK-day game of 18.01.2027 counts in tour 14 (19.01–24.01), not in tour 13.
(e) Card texts: the game ceiling is the player's own two-season P90, shifted to the per-game forecast; rookies and players with fewer than 10 logged games in two seasons get players of the same level. The ESPN source line shows ESPN's own projected games, with the known-absence cap in brackets. Season-ending OUT reports read «до конца сезона».
result.risks:
- rangeCoverage no longer falls back to gamesCoverage80. Cards built from a database without holdout.deployedGamesCoverage80 (the default-draft.json now deployed, generated 20.10, lacks it) show no games-range coverage until the next database build. This is deliberate: the old figure measured a different construction.
- windowFact's tour lookup assumes a club plays at most once per Moscow date, and that player game rows' `opponent` equals the club key in live.clubs. This holds for all 93 rows of the 21.10 snapshot. That snapshot predates the dd6a52a collector (no gone calendar entries), so tour placement only takes effect with snapshots from the new collector; until then the raw date is used, as before.
- shadowedHoldings relies on ctx.transfers and ctx.rosters being consistent (season-ui builds both from the same merged list). The UI note names the first holder that stints()/firstHolder picked.
- I left gamesView's «Игры составов» table (games of each team's 10 players) counting a shadowed player, since it describes players' games, not points. The Overview's «Игр до» column now excludes him, so the two can differ in a breach.
- The '⚖️' row note reuses the .sp-injury style (full row, warn colour); styles.css is not my file.
- Existing test changed: tests/season-ui.test.js. The old head regex became the new head, the audit fixture gained deployedGamesCoverage80 .7872, and the expected coverage went from 80 % to 79 %.
- The commit message ends with Co-Authored-By followed by the Claude-Session line from the harness attribution, the same as dd6a52a.
